'''Hence''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] soldier.

==Biography==
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Hence and some other elite soldiers were hired by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]] [[Purton]] to kill [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. The [[Squad/Legends|squad]] failed and was later tracked by Fett.
